PRIVATE LABEL TEXTILE MANUFACTURING · DENİZLİ, TÜRKİYE

From cotton to your brand.

Natural. Careful. Refined.

Berke Tekstil makes textiles for brands in Denizli, Türkiye. We choose the fibre, yarn and fabric, make the sample, produce on your approval and deliver under your label.

Fibre and texture

Every product starts with the right fabric. We choose it together for your collection and approve it with a sample.

Atelier

Your signature, in thread.

Logos, monograms and borders are stitched in our own atelier. Every piece meets the approved sample; we plan fabric to the pattern and put the gaps to use.

Private label

From idea to your door.

  • A sample from your R&D file or sample product
  • Fabric, trims and colour chosen together
  • Embroidery, print and woven labels
  • Your own labels and packaging
  • Photo updates at every step
  • Shipping with partner carriers

Collections

Five product groups.

Home TextilesBed, bath, table and kitchen, and decorative products. Fabric, embroidery and finish made for your brand. BabywearFrom muslin swaddles to bodysuits and sleepsuits. Fabric, trims and labels chosen with your brand. Hoodies & Sweatshirts Hoodies & SweatshirtsHoodies, sweatshirts and sets. Fabric, rib, embroidery or print from your design. Bags & Pencil Cases Bags & Pencil CasesTote bags, pencil cases and pouches; retail, school and corporate promotional series. Hotel & BathTowels, bathrobes and bed linen for hotels and hospitality brands, with logo embroidery.
